title: Weighted Lebesgue points of f for θ·μ⌞M along closed balls, a.e. on M ∩ B_r(y)
statement:
Let P ∈ ℕ and let μ be any measure on ℝ^P = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin P) (Borel σ-algebra). Let M ⊆ ℝ^P be μ-null-measurable, and let θ, f : ℝ^P → ℝ with θ > 0 on M. Let y ∈ ℝ^P and r ∈ ℝ, and suppose θ and θ·f are both μ-integrable on M ∩ B̄_r(y). Then for μ⌞(M ∩ B_r(y))-almost every x, as s → 0⁺ (quotient in [0, ∞]):
(∫⁻_{M∩B̄_s(x)} ofReal(θ(z))·‖f(z) − f(x)‖ₑ dμ(z)) / (∫⁻_{M∩B̄_s(x)} ofReal(θ(z)) dμ(z)) → 0.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Eucl P)) (M : Set (Eucl P)) (θ f : Eucl P → ℝ) (y : Eucl P) (r : ℝ), NullMeasurableSet M μ → (∀ z ∈ M, 0 < θ z) → IntegrableOn θ (M ∩ closedBall y r) μ → IntegrableOn (fun z => θ z * f z) (M ∩ closedBall y r) μ → ∀ᵐ x ∂(μ.restrict (M ∩ ball y r)), Tendsto (fun s : ℝ => (∫⁻ z in M ∩ closedBall x s, ENNReal.ofReal (θ z) * ‖f z - f x‖ₑ ∂μ) / (∫⁻ z in M ∩ closedBall x s, ENNReal.ofReal (θ z) ∂μ)) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0)
